What is in it:
- Protos: gateway.proto `Skill` gains version=7 and digest=8. runs.proto gains the new message `SkillPin` and `RunContextStatus.skills=4`.
- mp-contracts `status_json`: adds a `skills` key only when pins exist, so a status with no pins stamps exactly what it did before. A pins-only status stamps only `skills`. Ids, digests (64 hex characters only) and sources (a closed set) are sanitised, and at most 16 pins are kept.
- session-core `RecordRunContext`: now merges into `metadata.run_context` one level deeper, so a pins-only stamp and a parts stamp do not erase each other. A three-part stamp writes the same keys as before. One ignored database test was added.
- model-gateway, all behind `MODEL_GATEWAY_SKILL_PINS` (off unless the literal `true`):
  - `agent_skill_to_skill` copies version and digest only while the switch is on.
  - Builtin skills get version 0 and a digest that is the sha256 of the embedded SKILL.md with CRLF folded to LF (`builtin_skills::digest_of`).
  - `fetch_skill_context` pins every skill the turn set out to inject, including blocks the budget cut or dropped, because `reattach_skill` recovers exactly those.
  - The Ask path stamps the pins on the run record with a spawned `run_context::record_skill_pins`. It never runs for a ZDR or waived turn. A failed stamp is counted on `skill_pin_record_failed_total`.
  - `record_status` now returns a bool.
  - `chat_turn_registry` records a pinned skill as `id@version`. There is also a new in-process pin registry per (org, run) that recovery reads.
  - `reattach_skill` reads the pinned version through `GetAgentSkillVersion` when the cached row's digest has moved since the pin. A gone version returns a `not_available` text, and a failed read is an error; it never falls back to the current text.
  - The skill-mount lookup in tool_loop strips the `@version` suffix.
- orchestrator-core: `feedback.Normalize` strips `@version` with the new `SplitSkillRef`, so pinned ratings key and quarantine on the bare skill id. This is needed as soon as the gateway switch is on.
